blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Budget carrier AirAsia has reached a “very difficult decision” to downsize its workforce to manage the impact of rising jet fuel prices and currency pressures on its operations. In a statement on Thursday, AirAsia general manager and president Anna Victoria Lu announced the airline’s decision to reduce its workforce but did not provide additional details about the layoffs.
